text (K*=2), binary K*-aware filtering (0.5941 MMLU) outperforms graduated depth weighting (best 0.5892 at α=0.9), surprisal-based selection (0.5894), and DSIR distribution matching (~0.5867, ≈ no-filter level). K* serves as an actionable curation guideline — the domain-dependent discrimination boundary directly determines the optimal filtering granularity.\\n\\n### Supporting Analysis: Canonical Condition Selection\\nGeneration mode 是 depth estimation 的显著混淆变量。Methodology 段落阐述 continuation mode 作为 canonical condition 的选择及理由（不作为独立 claim）。\\n\\n## Story Spine\\n\\n- **Problem**: Web 数据正被多代递归合成文本污染。当前检测方法将合成文本视为 binary 类别（real vs synthetic），但质量随代际深度非线性退化——首代合成文本与四代合成文本的质量差异巨大却被忽视。\\n- **Existing approaches & gaps**: Binary detectors (DivEye, Min-K%++) 不区分代际；model collapse 文献 (Shumailov et al., Alemohammad et al. 2024, Dohmatob et al. 2024) 描述宏观现象但不提供检测工具；data selection methods (DSIR, D4, DoReMi) 做分布匹配但不估计递归深度；Drayson et al. (2025) 将 binary MGT detection 应用于 importance resampling 以防止 model collapse，是目前最接近的工作。然而这些方法均做二值判断，**不估计文本经历了多少轮递归生成，也不量化辨别能力的饱和边界。**\\n- **Our framing**: 将递归生成建模为 iterated lossy channel，从信息论（DPI）推导出 K* 的必然存在。K* 是首次系统测量的 operational quantity——它告诉数据策展者\\\"在什么深度以下，depth-aware curation 比 binary detection 更有价值\\\"。通过 8 model configurations（5 architecture families, 1B-8B）、3 source domains、4 decoding strategies 系统表征 K*，揭示其 **bounded domain-dependent** 本质：**K*∈{1,2,3}**，其中 web text K*=2（7/8 configurations），structured academic text K*=3（2/2 models cross-validated），少数 model-domain 组合 K*=1。这一发现意味着递归生成信息丧失极快——one to two generation passes suffice to erase distinguishable depth structure（\\\"one-wash laundering\\\" effect）。Domain dependence 为数据治理提供 actionable guidance：源文本的结构复杂度决定了 depth-aware filtering 的适用粒度。\\n- **Headline result template**: \\\"Recursive generation has a bounded discrimination boundary at K*∈{1,2,3}: web text saturates at K*=2 (7/8 model configurations, 5 architecture families, 1B-8B), while structured academic text extends to K*=3 (cross-validated across 2 independent architectures). Cross-model transfer retention of 80-92% and scorer-invariant feature ordering (ρ>0.90) confirm depth features are text-intrinsic. Domain-appropriate K* correctly predicts optimal curation granularity — binary filtering minimizes degradation most effectively for web text.\\\"\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns & Responses\\n\\n1. **\\\"K*∈{1,2,3} 范围太小，结论是否 trivial？\\\"** → 恰好相反：K* 的低有界性是核心发现。DPI 理论只保证 K* 有限但不给上界；我们首次实证表明 K*≤3（即递归信息丧失极快），且 domain dependence 揭示了结构化文本如何延缓信息退化。One-wash laundering effect 对 data governance 有直接实践意义。\\n2. **\\\"只基于小模型（≤8B），能推广到更大模型吗？\\\"** → 5 architecture families (1B-8B) 覆盖了当前开源生态的主要架构。DPI 理论保证 K*_theory 对任意规模模型存在。Cross-scorer validation 表明 K* 由生成过程而非评分模型决定。扩展至 13B+/70B+ 是重要 future work。\\n3. **\\\"只是 feature engineering + off-the-shelf classifier，方法贡献弱\\\"** → 贡献在 problem formulation + empirical characterization（首次测量 K*）+ 理论框架（DPI）+ domain-dependent bounded saturation 发现，不是分类器本身。Model-free features 的选择被 cross-model transfer 80-92% 和 scorer invariance 验证为正确设计。\\n4. **\\\"arXiv K*=3 只有 2 个模型验证，样本量小\\\"** → 每模型 n=2,200，bootstrap CI 确认统计显著。两个独立架构族（Qwen, Pythia）一致给出 K*=3，排除 model-specific artifact。进一步 cross-domain 扩展是 future work。\\n5. **\\\"Mistral K*=1 是 outlier 还是 systematic？\\\"** → Cross-scorer validation 确认是 text-intrinsic（非 scorer artifact）。Mistral 可能因训练数据/alignment 差异导致生成文本在一代后即失去 depth-distinguishing structure。这强化了 domain/model dependence 的核心论点。\\n6. **\\\"Prompt-chain 不代表真实世界递归污染\\\"** → Prompt-chain 是 controlled experiment 的标准方法（isolate generation effect from training dynamics）。Under monotonic-degradation assumptions, prompt-chain K* 是 retrain-chain K* 的 conservative upper bound。\\n7. **\\\"同模型做生成和 surprisal 计算有 bias\\\"** → **exp-013/exp-022 直接反驳**：cross-scorer validation 11/12 combos yield K*=2, Pythia↔OLMo 90-92% accuracy retention。K* governed by generation process, not scoring model.\\n8. **\\\"为什么不用 learned representations\\\"** → **exp-015 直接回应**：neural probe K* 是 model-dependent（Qwen=3, Pythia/OLMo=2），而 15D model-free features 给出一致的 K* across all models。Model-free 方案的 universality + cross-model transferability 是 practical advantage。\\n9. **\\\"θ=0.60 选择是否 arbitrary？\\\"** → 三层辩护：(1) Cohen's h≈0.20 small effect size threshold, (2) permutation test 校准, (3) AUC gap 在 boundary 处的 sharp discontinuity（1v2 vs 2v3 gap 大于 θ 选择的 sensitivity range）。θ-sensitivity analysis [0.55, 0.70] 在主文呈现。\\n10. **\\\"Graduated filtering 没和 data selection methods 比\\\"** → exp-006 包含 DSIR baseline + α sensitivity sweep，binary K*-aware filtering outperforms all tested alternatives。\\n\\n## Venue Fit\\n\\n- EMNLP 2026 special theme 明确呼吁 data contamination, synthetic data feedback loops, data governance 方向的工作\\n- 2+1 claim 结构：C1' 是 comprehensive characterization study with domain-dependent bounded saturation finding，C3 是 practical application，generation mode analysis 增加深度\\n- **Domain-dependent bounded saturation narrative** 比 universality 更准确且更有 impact：K*∈{1,2,3} 的 bounded range + domain dependence 是 nuanced scientific finding，比 \\\"K*=2 everywhere\\\" 更可信且更 interesting（审稿人不必怀疑过度外推）\\n- One-wash laundering effect 是 memorable concept 便于传播\\n- 风险：K* range 小（1-3）可能被认为 trivial → 论文须强调 bounded ≤3 本身是 surprising（DPI 不给上界），且 domain dependence 是 actionable（不同域需不同 curation 策略）\\n\", \"total_chars\": 11225, \"truncated\": false}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}

## Target Venue
- Primary: EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR submission May 25, 2026)
- Fallback: EMNLP 2026 Findings
- Backup: AAAI 2027 (abstract July 25, paper August 1)

## Canonical Experimental Condition

**Continuation mode 是 cross-model 结论的基础。**

> "We evaluate both generation modes because real-world recursive contamination can arise from either. Our analysis reveals generation mode as a significant confound, leading us to recommend continuation mode as the canonical condition for cross-model comparisons."

| Condition | Pythia↔OLMo | Qwen↔others | 论文定位 |
|-----------|-------------|-------------|---------|
| Continuation | 90-92% retention | 80-85% retention | **主实验条件** — cross-model claims 的基础 |
| Rewrite (instruction) | N/A | 61-63% retention | **upper bound with mode-specific confound** — 仅作 ablation |

**原则**：
- C1' 的跨模型 claim 必须基于 continuation mode 数据
- Rewrite mode 的高 AUC (0.6957 vs cont 0.6114) 是 mode-specific signal amplification，不能作为泛化性证据
- mvp-001 (Qwen-rewrite) 定位为 "pilot study demonstrating feasibility"，后续用 continuation mode rigorously validate
- cont→rw 89% vs rw→cont 82% 不对称性 → continuation features 是 rewrite 的通用子集

## Core Claims (2+1 结构, updated D049/D050)

### Primary: C1' (K* Characterization — Domain-Dependent Bounded Saturation)
首次系统测量递归合成文本的 generational discrimination boundary K*，demonstrating that K* is low-bounded (≤3) and domain-dependent。

DPI 理论证明有限 K*_theory 必然存在（信息论 impossibility boundary）；我们首次在受控实验中测量 K*_empirical，它提供 K*_theory 的保守下界。通过 8 model configurations（5 architecture families, 1B-8B）、3 source domains（C4, Wikipedia, arXiv）、4 decoding strategies 系统表征 K*_empirical 的行为，发现：

- **K*∈{1,2,3} at θ=0.60**：K* 是有界的且域依赖的
- **Web text K*=2 是 dominant mode**（7/8 configurations），展现跨模型架构、跨解码策略的一致性
- **Structured academic text (arXiv) K*=3**，经两个独立架构族 cross-validate（Qwen-1.5B, Pythia-1.4B）
- **Mistral-7B K*=1**：cross-scorer validation 确认是 text-intrinsic 而非 scorer artifact
- **One-wash laundering effect**：对 web text，单次生成即令文本与更深层合成内容不可区分

**子组件：**

**(a) K*=2 as dominant mode for web text (7/8 configurations)**
> **7/8 model configurations yield K*=2 on C4 web text：**
>
> | Model | Experiment | AUC 1v2 | 95% CI | CI lower > 0.60? |
> |-------|-----------|---------|--------|-----------------|

> | Qwen-1.5B-Instruct cont | exp-017 | 0.6112 | [0.6015, 0.6213] | ✅ (+0.15pp) |
>
> *Exception: Mistral-7B cont (exp-019): 1v2=0.5935, CI [0.5835, 0.6032], K*=1*
